usedFor: Brix runs your screens and content, and Microsoft Excel keeps the log that “Add Row To Table” writes.

bestTemplate.name: “New Media” in Brix, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each file added to the media library becomes a row, giving you a running inventory of screen content.

watchOut: “New Media” in Brix is polling, so rows land after a scheduled check and the Excel table must exist already.
